name: Clinic Desk
description: Front-desk appointment booking for a clinic: doctors' weekly hours, profiles and leave, free slots that cannot be double-booked, day, week and month calendars, a patient directory, results and attention prompts, and a spoken day brief. Everything stays on this computer.
author: Vakyartha

listen.label: Listen to or watch the day's appointments

tools.name: get_clinic_context
tools.title: Read the clinic schedule
tools.description: Read the clinic's doctors, one day's appointments (patients by first name and initial, no phone numbers or notes), attendance risk estimates, the next seven days' load and the current expectedRevision. Read-only.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today at the clinic

tools.name: find_free_slots
tools.title: Find free appointment slots
tools.description: List open appointment times for one doctor, or every doctor, over the next days. Read-only.

doctorId.description: A doctor id from get_clinic_context; omit for all doctors

tools.name: get_attention_list
tools.title: Read what needs attention
tools.description: Read the front desk's prompts: likely no-shows to call, waiting-list patients who could take an open slot, missed visits not rebooked, check-up recalls and full days that may lose visits. Rule-based, each with its reason. Read-only.

tools.name: get_insights
tools.title: Read clinic results
tools.description: Read results for the last 7, 30 or 90 days, optionally for one doctor: completed, no-show and cancellation counts, slots used, days booked ahead, busiest hours and no-show rate by weekday. No patient details. Read-only.

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.title: Fill in the Book form
tools.description: Fill in Clinic Desk's Book form with a free slot and the patient's details. It does not book anything: a person must review the form and press Book. Read current expectedRevision first. Requires integration permission.
